summary: Complete the already-approved one-domain migration by making ekodi.kr/my the canonical private workspace and My feature path in the constitutional routing patterns while retaining my.ekodi.kr only as a compatibility execution boundary.
approvalBasis: The platform owner previously approved the one-domain multiple-security-realms model on 2026-09-08 and in this task explicitly instructed EKODI to continue through implementation, verification and production completion.
compatibilityPolicy: Legacy my.ekodi.kr may remain only where required for redirect, runtime, OAuth/CORS transition or rollback compatibility; new first-party user navigation must use ekodi.kr/my.
securityImpact: No security realm or authority is merged. Existing authentication, authorization, CSP, rate-limit and audit boundaries remain enforced behind the canonical path router.
rollback: Revert this amendment and the two constitutional canonical path fields through the guarded release path while preserving the legacy My runtime boundary.
